title: TimeES: Probabilistic and Deterministic Time Series Forecasting via Evolutionary Spectra
abstract: arXiv:2609.32384v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Real-world time series are inherently non-stationary, with trends, periodic patterns, and uncertainty evolving over time. While the Fourier domain offers a natural lens to model time series, current deep learning approaches do not explicitly model evolution and randomness in the Fourier spectra, which limits their ability to accurately predict both the expected trajectory and its uncertainty in non-stationary time series. Motivated by Evolutionary Spectra (ES) theory, we propose TimeES, a general framework that enables probabilistic and deterministic forecasting via the evolutionary spectra theory. Specifically, we derive a parameterizable evolutionary spectra formulation, recasting non-stationary random process modeling as learning an evolving representation modulated by random variables. translated_title: TimeES：基于演化谱的概率性与确定性时间序列预测
translated_abstract: 现实世界中的时间序列本质上是非平稳的，其趋势、周期模式和不确定性随时间不断演变。虽然傅里叶域为时间序列建模提供了一个自然的视角，但当前的深度学习方法并未显式地建模傅里叶谱中的演变与随机性，这限制了它们在非平稳时间序列中同时准确预测期望轨迹及其不确定性的能力。受演化谱理论启发，我们提出了TimeES，一个基于演化谱理论实现概率性与确定性预测的通用框架。具体而言，我们推导了一种可参数化的演化谱公式，将非平稳随机过程建模重新表述为学习由随机变量调制的演化表示。此外，我们利用厄米对称性和谱特性，将估计谱的复杂度从O(NM)降低到O(NK)，其中K << M/2。
tldr: 提出TimeES框架，基于演化谱理论显式建模傅里叶谱中的演变与随机性，将非平稳随机过程建模转化为学习由随机变量调制的演化表示，并利用厄米对称性将谱估计复杂度从O(NM)降至O(NK)，从而实现对非平稳时间序列的概率性与确定性预测。
en_tdlr: TimeES is a general framework built on Evolutionary Spectra theory that explicitly models the evolution and randomness in Fourier spectra, recasting non-stationary random process modeling as learning random-variable-modulated evolving representations while reducing spectral estimation complexity from O(NM) to O(NK), thereby enabling both probabilistic and deterministic forecasting of non-stationary time series.
